full_gate: All 201 original tail orientation samples within 0.99–1.01 times abs(initial orientation), plus original success gate
original_gate: Original orientation >0.05 throughout tail, contrast >=0.05, orientation temporal range <0.005
physical_patch_rule: Original cosine patch restricted to actual cell domain. Integral-matched peak uses actual truncated cosine integral if domain shorter than support width.
alias_rule: Static reference-length cues are identical; Spring retains distinct dynamic-domain cues
initial_states: Exact canonical revision-11 release checkpoints, no reconditioning
